structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son and the bank. Harel takes about half a percent a year from the savings on most tracks (only 0.01% on חיסכון לכל ילד), and nothing there looked like a safe deposit. The closest was 'כספי (שקלי)' with 4.25% over 3 years, but many tracks show no returns at all.
